question.problem:
From top to bottom, fill in the blanks and hence complete the proof of the following statement using the axioms $[\text{A}1]-[\text{A}8]$ given below.

*Statement:* 

*$\alpha 0=0$ for any $\alpha \in R$*

*Proof:* 

$$
\begin{aligned}\alpha 0 & =\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{given}\,] \\ \alpha 0 & =\alpha (0+0) &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,] \\ \alpha 0 & =\alpha 0+\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{axiom __}\,\,] \\ \alpha 0+(-\alpha 0) & =(\alpha 0+\alpha 0)+(-\alpha 0) &  & [\,\text{add }-\alpha 0\text{ to both sides}\,] \\ \alpha 0+(-\alpha 0) & =\alpha 0+(\alpha 0+(-\alpha 0)) &  & [\,\text{axiom A2}\,] \\ 0 & =\alpha 0+0 &  & [\,\text{axiom __}\,\,] \\ 0 & =\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,]\end{aligned}
$$

The axioms:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{[A1]}:x+y=y+x & \text{[A5]}:1\cdot x=x \\ \text{[A2]}:(x+y)+z=x+(y+z) & \text{[A6]}:\alpha (\beta x)=(\alpha \beta )x \\ \text{[A3]}:x+0=x & \text{[A7]}:(\alpha +\beta )x=\alpha x+\beta x \\ \text{[A4]}:x+(-x)=0 & \text{[A8]}:\alpha (x+y)=\alpha x+\alpha y\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
Using the vector space axioms, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}\alpha 0 & =\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{given}\,] \\ \alpha 0 & =\alpha (0+0) &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,] \\ \alpha 0 & =\alpha 0+\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{axiom }\text{A8}\,] \\ \alpha 0-\alpha 0 & =(\alpha 0+\alpha 0)-\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{add }-\alpha 0\text{ to both sides}\,] \\ \alpha 0-\alpha 0 & =\alpha 0+(\alpha 0-\alpha 0) &  & [\,\text{axiom A2}\,] \\ 0 & =\alpha 0+0 &  & [\,\text{axiom }\text{A4}\,] \\ 0 & =\alpha 0 &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,]\end{aligned}
$$
